video_title: Toronto Raptors Full Media Availability | Post Game at Denver Nuggets | November 04, 2026

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on the Raptors' need to eliminate bad quarters
quotes.excerpt: having that one bad quarter, we got to eliminate that
quotes.quote: Since I've been here, we generally played good against this team. Somehow, they figure it out every time, but we started good today, which was a positive. I think we won every quarter except the third, but then obviously the third was horrible. So, it's like, forget anything that they did, obviously give them credit, but for us, having that one bad quarter, we got to eliminate that. There's going to be stretches throughout every game where we probably don't play as well or the other team goes on a run, but we got to figure out how to eliminate those and just get back to what we're doing.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett says the Raptors must find a way to eliminate bad quarters after a rough third period against Denver. He noted that while the team played good basketball for most of the night, one bad stretch cost them the game.

structured.context: RJ Barrett discusses the Raptors' performance against the Nuggets and the team's need to eliminate poor stretches during games.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on Nikola Jokic's dominant performance
quotes.excerpt: you have to go up against a challenge like that tonight
quotes.quote: Every game is different. Today, they just went on a crazy run. Obviously, you have a player like Jokic over there. I think there was a stat like it was his 90th triple-double game before the fourth quarter. So, you have to go up against a challenge like that tonight. At the end of the day, throughout four quarters, we played good basketball, so we just got to continue to bring that trend into the next game and that third quarter, we can't let something like that happen again.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett on facing Nikola Jokic after the Nuggets star dominated the game. Barrett acknowledged the challenge of playing against a player who can record a triple double before the fourth quarter even begins.

structured.context: RJ Barrett reacts to the challenge of playing against Nikola Jokic and the Nuggets following a loss.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on Raptors' third-quarter struggles and turnovers
quotes.excerpt: we didn't take care of the ball in the third quarter, we had I believe seven turnovers
quotes.quote: Third quarter, we missed, I believe, four or five straight shots, and on the other side, they just scored right after, one position after the other. They had a great run over there. Jokic with his post-ups, they came with a different mindset in the second half. They were more aggressive, they did a better job on the closeouts, and we didn't take care of the ball in the third quarter. We had, I believe, seven turnovers that led to easy points. They scored 76 points in the paint, and that's unacceptable. We got to be much better defensively there.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic called the Raptors defensive performance unacceptable after allowing 76 points in the paint. He pointed to seven third quarter turnovers as the primary reason the team lost momentum against Denver.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic analyzes the Raptors' third-quarter struggles, turnovers, and defensive issues against the Nuggets.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on the difficulty of defending Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: if he's going to score one-on-one against smaller guards or if you put two on the ball
quotes.quote: He was efficient in the paint scoring, and we ended up in a couple of situations that we ended up late switching, and some of the guards ended up on him, and that's very hard. If he's going to score one-on-one against smaller guards or if you put two on the ball, he's going to find open men. I thought that he did a masterclass offensively there in that third quarter of playmaking and scoring.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic described Nikola Jokic as a masterclass in playmaking and scoring. The Raptors coach noted that late switches left smaller guards in impossible situations against the Nuggets star.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic explains the tactical difficulty of defending Nikola Jokic when he exploits defensive switches.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on maintaining offensive consistency throughout the game
quotes.excerpt: we just got to make sure that we can sustain that
quotes.quote: I saw a lot of positives in this game. I thought that we managed the ball movement was much better. We had 20 assists in the first half. We just got to make sure that we can sustain that. We talked about opening the game better, which we had much better energy in that first quarter. We did not match that in the third quarter. We got to find a way how to sustain that over the course of the whole game.
quotes.social_post: Despite the loss, Darko Rajakovic saw positives in the Raptors ball movement. He noted the team had 20 assists in the first half and emphasized that the challenge is to sustain that offensive consistency for all four quarters.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic discusses the need for the Raptors to maintain offensive consistency and ball movement throughout the entire game.
